name: Sit-Down Lunch Pennette Pasta with Goat Cheese & Spinach Pesto
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
whyItWorks: Refined white pennette pasta with creamy goat cheese; can easily be ordered with plain butter/Parmesan or grilled chicken.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If tomato-basil Provençal sauce bothers you, ask for the pennette tossed in butter and aged Parmesan topped with a grilled chicken breast.
watchOuts: Tomato acidity and garlic in Provençal sauce
